Choose a tool by its job

Signal Forge contains two views of one circuit: Circuit Lab shows topology; Signal Lab shows the supported electrical model. The Generator makes a build reference, Designer explores bleeds in depth, and Builder resolves purchasable kits.

Signal Forge / Circuit Lab →

Inspect the supported circuit topology, contacts and conductive paths.

Signal Forge / Signal Lab →

Compare electrical voltage transfer for one selected pickup with Modern wiring. Both, 50s and 60s response remain outside this model.

Wiring Generator →

Create a physical connection list, conductor reference and printable bench diagram.

Treble Bleed Designer →

Explore capacitor-only and RC networks with explicit pickup, pot and cable assumptions.

Kit Builder →

Configure a supported purchasable kit, then review brands, dimensions, fitment, availability and price.

Knowledge stays accessible

Core guitar-electronics understanding and useful baseline tools belong in an accessible experience. Future advanced workflow and convenience should build on that foundation.
